patch.description: A new version of the Item; it dismisses the Item's flag.

schema.title: Response Messages Api Chats  Chat Id  Messages Get

get.description: The Chat's jobs with the Items they added, oldest first.

schema.title: Response Jobs Api Chats  Chat Id  Jobs Get

post.description: "Wgraj mimo to": the near-duplicate becomes an Item.

get.description: Tenant users to pick as Students, by name.
The teams the Teacher owns and has not linked yet.

schema.title: Response Owned Teams Api Teams Get

get.description:
The roster is brought in step with the team first, as when the Class page opens. That also
releases a Class whose team is back, and deletes one held for 30 days, with its Notes.

delete.description:
Deletes the Class and its team once its name is typed, then its Notes. They go last, so
a refused deletion loses nothing; a failure between the two leaves Notes no Class can reach.

get.description:
One row per recipient in the Class's order, for typing the grades into the e-gradebook.
Semicolons and a BOM, so Excel opens it in Polish.
`start` and `end` bound the period by due time; leaving both out means everything.
Opening the tab brings the Lessons in step with the Teacher's Teams calendar first.

post.description: The Items for the preview, line by line; no Item twice.
"Podmień na inne": another Item of the same cell that the preview does not hold.

Give the Assignment now or at `publish_at`: `teams` posts the Items PDF and tells the
Students, and `items` pins the Items.

BankFilters.title: BankFilters
BankFilters.description:
What the screen offers to filter and tag by: the Curriculum, the General requirements and the
Classes.

Choice.title: Choice
Choice.description: One answer to a question on the queue: `answer` is what `teams` is told.

HandIn.title: HandIn
HandIn.description: Which hand-in of the Submission the change is to: the one the page showed.

Item.title: Item
Item.description: An Item's record with its current version.

ItemChanges.title: ItemChanges
ItemChanges.description: What the Teacher changed; what is left out stays as it was.

ItemContent.title: ItemContent
ItemContent.description: What a version says; all mathematics is inline LaTeX.

ItemVersion.title: ItemVersion
ItemVersion.description: An immutable version of an Item, as Assignments pin it.

Line.title: Line
Line.description:
What the Teacher asked of one cell of the table: `count` Items of a Curriculum section at
one Difficulty.

Mistake.title: Mistake
Mistake.description: A Common mistake on one Item, as `grading` found it.

Override.title: Override
Override.description: None takes the Teacher's state away, back to the one derived from Teams.

Placed.title: Placed
Placed.description: A previewed Item and the cell it was picked for, which a swap draws from again.

Point.title: Point
Point.description:
One Given Assignment on the chart, at its due time. Missing and Excused leave a gap, never
a 0; a Submission not yet graded or still Held has no point either.

Reason.title: Reason
Reason.description: Why a Submission is Held or flagged, with the numbers of the Items that caused it.

SectionCount.title: SectionCount
SectionCount.description: How many Items a Curriculum section has at one Difficulty.

Slot.title: Slot
Slot.description: A weekly Timetable slot; weekday 0 is Monday, times are Warsaw wall-clock.

SwapRequest.title: SwapRequest
SwapRequest.description: A previewed Item's cell, and every Item the preview holds.

Thresholds.title: Thresholds
Thresholds.description: The lowest percent for grades 2 to 6.

TypeProgress.title: TypeProgress
TypeProgress.description: Progress on one Assignment type; `average` is its points earned over available.

UsageEntry.title: UsageEntry
UsageEntry.description:
An Item Given to a Class in an Assignment, with how the Class did on it. The title and
name are missing when `teams` no longer knows the Assignment or the Class.

WeeklySlot.title: WeeklySlot
WeeklySlot.description: A slot as the Teacher enters it; weekday 0 is Monday, times are Warsaw wall-clock.
